title: The Heart of Thomas
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: At a German boys' boarding school in the mid-20th century, fourteen-year-old Thomas Werner dies in a fall from an overpass after mailing a love letter to fellow student Juli (Fantagraphics blurb). Juli, scholarly and burdened by guilt and a hidden past, sinks into despair while his roommate Oscar watches over him; then a new boy, Erich, who looks just like Thomas, arrives. A 1974 classic of shojo manga steeped in Christian imagery (MangaUpdates; ANN).
life_message: Love that gives itself can break through guilt and self-hatred, letting a wounded person accept being loved and forgiven.

content.note: Juli's 'fairly horrific' past, mostly told not shown (ANN); bullying and a rape spoiler tag (AniList).
Tragedy, despair and angst throughout (AniList, MangaUpdates); melodramatic (ANN).
Romantic feelings among boys aged around 14; kissing kept 'fairly coy' (ANN); shounen-ai genre (MangaUpdates).
Thomas's death is a suicide (ANN); depression and suicide categories (MangaUpdates, AniList).
Suicide framed as a gift of love; parents may want to discuss.
